comments.text: The floating communities are so fascinating! How do they manage life on the water? 🤔

replies.author: @VagariousTravel-868
replies.text: Great question. Their whole way of life is built around water. In places like Tonlé Sap in Cambodia, homes float on bamboo rafts or oil drums and simply rise with the water. Others use very high stilts. During heavy rains, entire villages can be towed to safer spots. Some communities, like the Uros in Peru, add fresh reed layers to their floating islands to stay dry. It's not easy, but they've adapted over generations.
